category: S3-compatible object storage, Local Zone deployment

free_tier.stated: No free tier: the Standard class in a Local Zone is billed from the first GiB at USD 0.00001111 per GiB-hour (about USD 0.0081103 per GiB-month), with no capacity cap stated
free_tier.notes: billed per GiB-hour; the monthly figure is the hourly price x 730 hours

per_object_cap.stated: 48 TiB per object through multipart upload; 5 GiB through a single PUT
per_object_cap.notes: the Object Storage technical limits page states one set of limits for the Object Storage offer

retention.stated: unlimited volume and time: objects are kept until deleted, and no minimum storage duration is stated for the Local Zone Standard class
retention.notes: the Local Zone price table has no minimum storage column

egress.terms: External ingoing and outgoing traffic, internal traffic, data retrieval and API requests are all free

tooling: AWS CLI, rclone, s3cmd, any S3 SDK; lifecycle rules move objects between classes
chaining: S3 origin behind a CDN or proxy; lifecycle rules move objects between this class and the Standard class

limits.value: 48 TiB per object by multipart upload; 5 GiB by a single PUT
300 PUT and 900 GET requests per second per bucket, soft defaults

limits_note: Local Zones run a single availability zone: 99.9% availability SLA; multi-AZ, High Performance, server-side encryption at rest, user policies and the metadata API are not available there
binding_note: none: storage has no stated cap, an object may reach 48 TiB, and the per-bucket rates are soft defaults; the Local Zone feature gaps (no multi-AZ, no High Performance, no encryption at rest by the service, no user policies) are capability notes, not quotas

identity_cost.detail: an email address validated by a one-time code, the country of tax residence, and a valid payment method on the account before the first Public Cloud project

reliability_note: 99.9% availability SLA in 1-AZ regions and Local Zones; MonoAZ only, with no multi-AZ in a Local Zone
confidence_note: documented: the international price list, the storage classes pages, the endpoints page and the technical limits page were read and quoted on 2026-11-03; a read timed from a bucket would make it measured

evidence.proved: the Local Zone Standard class costs USD 0.00001111 per GiB-hour, about USD 0.0081103 per GiB-month, with free traffic, retrieval and API requests

evidence.quote: For optimal readability, the price is displayed as GiB/month – but since there are 730 hours in an average month, the invoicing granularity is GiB/hour.
evidence.proved: Object Storage is invoiced per GiB-hour and the monthly figure assumes 730 hours

evidence.quote: The level of availability depends on the deployment mode chosen: 99.9% service level agreement (SLA) in 1-AZ and Local Zones, 99.99% SLA in our 3-AZ regions.
evidence.proved: the availability SLA is 99.9% in 1-AZ regions and Local Zones

evidence.quote: High Performance: High-performance storage classes are not available in Local Zones at this time. Only standard storage classes are supported.
evidence.proved: a Local Zone offers the Standard class only

evidence.quote: MonoAZ configurations are available in Local Zones, making them suitable for use cases that prioritize performance and low latency over cross-zone redundancy.
Encryption is not supported in Local Zones, meaning that data is not encrypted at rest by the service.
evidence.proved: Local Zones have no server-side encryption at rest, only customer-provided keys

evidence.quote: | Maximum Object size | 48 TiB | This maximum can be achieved using Multi-Part Upload (MPU), via a single PUT request, the maximum object size is 5 GiB |
evidence.proved: the largest object is 48 TiB by multipart upload and 5 GiB by a single PUT
Object Storage bandwidth is 1 Gbps per connection, lifted by parallel requests
the default write rate is 300 requests per second on a bucket, a soft limit

evidence.quote: You need to add a valid payment method to your OVHcloud customer account before starting the free trial, which will be used after your free trial ends, if you want to keep running the project you have launched.
evidence.proved: a valid payment method is required on the account before the first Public Cloud project

evidence.quote: After you submit this form, a one-time code will be sent to the email address you entered.
evidence.proved: account creation validates the email address with a one-time code

price_per_tb_month: USD 7.55 per TB per month (USD 0.0081103 per GiB-month x 931.32 GiB per TB); one rate at every volume
notes: only the Standard class is offered in a Local Zone; every access key of a project reaches every bucket in the Local Zones
